description: The disc files that are movies, in disc order. file: the disc path; its last part is the name a replacement goes by (a mod's FMV/<name>.avi or .mp4, gamedata/fmv/<name>.avi). sectors: the length of the file on the disc, in sectors. How many frames a movie plays comes from the disc's file table. The console command fmv lists these by position. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.
